Gower Champion / David Merrick backstage musical named for the street itself.

How 42nd Street (musical) connects

  • Location: 42nd Street — The musical 42nd Street takes its name and myth from the Midtown street.
  • Topic: Broadway — 42nd Street is a backstage musical about Broadway itself.

What is 42nd Street (musical)?

42nd Street is the 1980 Merrick musical of kids-from-the-chorus lore, named for the Midtown street, that opened as Champion died and became a Tony-winning valentine to the district.

Key threads lead to 42nd Street and Broadway.
